verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk capability in the evidence is ingestion: Secureframe lets you push raw data via an API endpoint or CSV upload to create custom resources, and pull user data by CSV for access reviews. That is a bulk create/import of many items at once, but nothing documents bulk editing, updating, or acting on many existing items, whether in the UI, through the API, or through the MCP server. missing for 10: bulk update/delete/assign actions on existing objects, documented batch API endpoints, bulk actions via MCP for AI agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
